about: Every car on the rig: what kind it is, whether it has ABS, traction control and adjustable brake bias, and every control it gives the driver, with the label the car uses. Written by hand; see README.md.

controls.label: BAL
controls.note: Dash: BAL. Garage: Brake Pressure Bias. Variable by analogy with the driven GTP cars.

controls.label: TC1
controls.note: Traction control slip (dash: TC1 Map): higher acts on less wheelspin. Variable by analogy: on the driven GTP cars dcTractionControl carries slip.

controls.label: TC2
controls.note: Traction control gain (dash: TC2 Map): higher cuts harder. Variable by analogy with the driven GTP cars.

controls.label: BRAKE MIGRATION
controls.note: Added to this car in 2025 Season 3 Patch 3. Variable by analogy: on every driven GTP car the migration is carried by dcABS, and the car has no ABS.

controls.label: FARB
controls.note: Front ARB blades. Black box: FARB. Dash: ARB F/R. Variable by analogy with the driven GTP cars.

controls.label: RARB

controls.note: By analogy with the driven GTP cars, which all publish it. What its values mean is not confirmed.
